what.text: This page follows refugees from Latvia in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 189 Latvian refugees, and Russia hosted 46.0% of them.
After Russia, the largest hosts are France, the United States and Germany.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Latvia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1996 to 1997 and 2002 to 2005.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1992 at 5 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 3173, at the end of 2003.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
